content.title: About
content.content: Baby Toddler fruit and meat (4122) is a ready‑to‑eat baby food that combines carefully selected fruits and lean meat, designed for children aged 6 months to 3 years. The product is gently heat‑treated to retain most vitamins and minerals, has a smooth texture and a pleasant taste, making the transition from breast‑feeding to solid foods easier.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The fruit‑meat blend provides a wide range of nutrients in a single serving.
Made from 100 % natural ingredients with no artificial colours, flavours or preservatives.
Fruits (apple, pear, banana) are rich in vitamins C and A, while the meat (turkey, chicken) supplies high‑quality protein and iron.
Low‑temperature processing preserves most bioactive compounds.
Packaged in safe, reusable food‑grade plastic.

items.title: Supports growth and development
items.content: The combination of meat protein and fruit vitamins promotes normal tissue growth, muscle development and nervous system maturation in toddlers.

items.title: Boosts immunity
items.content: Vitamin C from fruits and zinc from meat help strengthen the immune system and increase resistance to infections.

items.title: Digestive health
items.content: Fruit dietary fibre supports regular bowel movements and helps prevent constipation.

items.title: Energy supply
items.content: Natural fruit sugars provide a quick source of energy, while protein offers sustained satiety.

items.title: Iron content
items.content: Meat provides easily absorbable iron, important for preventing anemia in young children.

items.title: Allergy
items.content: Children may be allergic to individual ingredients (e.g., chicken or certain fruits). Observe for reactions when first introducing the product.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Although the sugar is natural, children prone to dental caries should have the product offered in moderation.

items.title: Not suitable for infants under 6 months
items.content: Because of texture and composition, the product is intended only for babies older than six months.

items.title: Post‑opening storage
items.content: After opening, keep the container refrigerated and use within 48 hours to prevent bacterial growth.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve at room temperature. It can be warmed to about 37 °C in the microwave (10‑15 seconds), then mixed well before offering to the child. If a thinner consistency is needed, add a small amount of breast milk or formula.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the unopened package in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight, not exceeding 25 °C. After opening, keep refrigerated and consume within 48 hours. Discard if you notice off‑odors, colour changes or altered texture.
